title: fix(console): the Settings pages send the session language, so server-composed copy matches the page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FyqJR42pdMEnHR57kzbNCK)_
Fixes #33857

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台「设置」页的四个请求（读设置列表、读某个命名空间、保存、执行动作）现在带上会话界面语言作为 `Accept-Language`，取值来源是页面根元素的 `lang` 属性（`document.documentElement.lang`），和元数据、数据请求用的同一个来源。
- 为什么改：服务端按请求语言拼文案（本地化页的「默认币种已锁定」横幅、保存被拒的提示、动作结果），之前这四个请求只带浏览器自己的语言，中文会话在英文浏览器上看到的这几处是英文，页面其余部分是中文。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `settings/api.ts` 的请求头构造；没有界面语言时不发这个头，行为与之前完全相同；不碰服务端、不碰鉴权。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/api.ts` 的 `jsonHeaders`；再看 `api.envelope.test.ts` 末尾新增的一组测试。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/api.envelope.test.ts`，预期 28 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`jsonHeaders()` in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/api.ts` is the header set all four `/api/settings` calls send (`listSettingsManifests`, `getSettingsNamespace`, `saveSettingsNamespace`, `runSettingsAction`). It now adds `Accept-Language` from `document.documentElement.lang` when that is non-empty.

- Source: the html element's `lang` attribute is what `createAuthenticatedFetch` in `@object-ui/auth` stamps on the console's metadata and data calls, and the i18n provider keeps it in step with the language switcher. No second locale source is introduced; the docblock says the two stamps must agree.
- The server side is unchanged: `requestLocaleOf` in `service-settings`' `settings-routes.ts` already reads the top `Accept-Language` tag (the card measured `curl -H 'Accept-Language: zh-CN'` answering the zh-CN currency-lock copy).
- Unchanged: with no `lang` on the html element the header is left out and the browser's own goes, as before. `getJudgedClientAddress` (the `/api/v1/auth` client-address read in the same module) is not one of the four calls and returns no composed copy; it is untouched.

## Tests

One new top-level `describe` in the module's existing harness `api.envelope.test.ts` (no new file), against the harness's `fetch` stub:

- each of the four calls, with the html element's `lang` set to `zh-Hans`, sends `Accept-Language: zh-Hans` and keeps `Accept` / `Content-Type: application/json`;
- CONTROL: each of the four calls with an empty `lang` on the html element sends no `Accept-Language`;
- a language switch between two calls reaches the second (`['en', 'zh-Hans']`).

No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- Routing these four calls through `createAuthenticatedFetch` itself (the move `services/approvalsApi.ts` made) was weighed and not taken here: it also adds the bearer, `X-Tenant-ID`, session-rotation adoption and the 401/403 session events to the settings calls, and every settings test whose `fetch` double has no `headers` member (about 14 files under `pages/settings/__tests__/`) would need a forced edit, because that transport reads `response.headers`. That is a transport change, not this card's. Left as an open question for the seat.
- The card's acceptance (the Localization banner reads `默认币种已锁定：USD` on a zh-CN session) is pinned at the request layer here; it was not re-measured in a browser against a live server. The card's own curl control shows the server answers that copy for `Accept-Language: zh-CN` / `zh-Hans`.

Red: the four "sends the session language" cases and the language-switch case. The four CONTROL cases stay green. Restore: blob == HEAD 55abaf1f, `git diff HEAD` empty.
